steps.text: Main board in the middle; Synagogue board and structure beside it (tray lined up with its actions)
Pass tiles next to the Synagogue board
Split Character cards into I-III and IV decks; 1 from IV in the rightmost Palace space, 3 from I-III in the others, faceup
Shuffle the Book cards onto the Library; 5 faceup next to it
Shuffle each color of Neighborhood tiles; 7 per district in ascending order
Shuffle the Action tiles facedown on the Synagogue board; reveal {n} top to bottom
Shuffle the Objective cards facedown near the board
Marbles into the Synagogue (white/black/red/blue/yellow): {n}
Matching Menorah token on each district between spaces VII and VIII
Clay, Coin, Knowledge and Gold by type as the general supply
Each player: a Player board and all pieces of one color
Development tiles: Study across the top (grey up), Golem ones over the Golem image, Artifact ones on the right
4 Golems on your board; 2 aside for the main board
A Student on the first space of each of the 3 streets
Markers on Study 0, Golem track 3, VP 10 and the Turn Order track; Rabbi and Summary card beside your board
Random turn order on the Turn Order track
Deal each player 4 Starting tiles
Deal 4 Objectives each; draft them to 4, keep 3
Reveal one Artifact tile per player; in reverse turn order each takes one
Choose 2 of your 4 Starting tiles and take their benefits
In turn order place your 2 Golems on the leftmost blocks of 2 different districts
Replace the Artifact Development tiles with the Special Development tiles
The Automa is first player and takes the last Artifact tile
Give it random Starting tiles equal to the difficulty and 3 random Objectives; you draw 6 and keep 3
Resource track at the chosen difficulty with its marker on 0; Main Strategy tile with the 3 colored ones shuffled below
Its 2 Golems go to the districts of the top two colored Strategy tiles
Shuffle the Automa cards facedown by the Resource track
9 Mechanism tokens on the three Student streets: one under columns III, V and VII of each
Board extension below the main board
Shuffle the 3 Mission decks separately, facedown next to the board
1 neutral Golem on the leftmost block of each district
Each player: a Mission board next to their player board with 6 cubes of their color on it
10 extra Gold pieces into the supply
In turn order place your Rabbi on an Action tile, then take marble actions
